name: Dungavenhooter
description: A fearsome critter of North American lumberjack folklore: a mouthless, alligator-like swamp creature that pounds its victims to vapor with its tail and inhales them through its enormous nostrils.
origin: Folkloric range across the swampy lumberwoods of the northeastern United States and the upper Great Lakes, broadly between Maine and Michigan as recorded in Tryon's 1939 catalogue.
